preview_r2.Description: Unique predictivity: predictivity of the full 9-predictor model minus that of the same model without this predictor. Predictivity: signed squared Spearman correlation, sign(r) * r^2, between predicted and observed held-out values of the per-image mean log detection latency (log of the geometric mean across participants), averaged over the 100 folds of 50 balanced repeated two-fold splits over images, divided by the split-half reliability of the condition (config.RELIABILITY). Condition: preview.

preview_sd_across_folds.Description: Standard deviation of the value across the 100 cross-validation folds. Folds overlap, so this is descriptive and is not used for inference. For preview_r2.

preview_p.Description: One-sided permutation p for predictivity > 0: latencies shuffled across images and the whole cross-validation rerun, 5000 permutations, p = (1 + #null >= observed) / (1 + 5000). For preview_r2.

preview_p_bonferroni.Description: preview_p multiplied by 20 (ten features x two conditions), capped at 1.
